europe_now.title: Russian Attacks Strike Infrastructure in Kyiv and Spark Airspace Violation in Moldova
europe_now.summary: Russian forces targeted a major bridge and logistics hub in Kyiv while attack debris landed in neighboring Moldova during an airspace violation. Moldovan leadership strongly condemned the latest cross-border security breach amid ongoing regional hostilities.

sources.headline: Russia hits second major bridge in Ukraine's capital Kyiv
Sandu slams Russia as attack debris hits Moldova in latest airspace violation

europe_now.title: Housing Protests and Legislative Rejections Stir Political Uncertainty in Spain
europe_now.summary: Fresh protests erupted across Spain after lawmakers rejected proposed housing relief measures in parliament. The escalating crisis has intensified political pressure, with potential implications for Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government.

sources.headline: Spaniards protest housing crisis as Sánchez weighs snap vote
Fresh protests over housing flare in Spain after lawmakers reject relief measures

top_stories.title: Latvian Electoral Outcome
top_stories.summary: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs secured a bittersweet victory in Latvia's national elections. The political outcome unfolded against a tense backdrop of heightened regional security concerns involving Russia.

sources.headline: Latvian PM faces bittersweet victory in election backdropped by Russia

top_stories.title: Polish Nuclear Strategy Updates
top_stories.summary: Poland has officially updated its national nuclear energy strategy. The revised plans include notable delays regarding the anticipated launch dates for its first two nuclear power plants.

sources.headline: Poland updates nuclear strategy with delays to launch of first two plants

top_stories.title: Security Threat Charge in the UK
top_stories.summary: A suspect linked to the Widdecombe murder investigation has been formally charged with planning a terrorist act against politician Nigel Farage. British authorities announced the updated charges following ongoing security inquiries.

sources.headline: Widdecombe murder suspect charged with planning terror act on Nigel Farage
